## Two layer MLP with downsampling

`quarto preview mlp_two_lyr_downsampled/mlp_two_lyr_downsampled.qmd --no-browser --no-watch-inputs`


```{python}
#| label: ImportPkgs
#| echo: true

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import pickle
import joblib
import torch
from torch import nn
import sys, os

# Quarto renders each chapter from its own directory; go up one level to
# reach src/ at the repo root
sys.path.insert(0, '..')
from src.models import FeedforwardTwo as Feedforward

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

```

### Defining a two layer MLP model

Build a model using ReLU activation function between hidden layers. I was going to use a sigmoid output for the binary classification but took some advice from ChatGPT to use `BCEWithLogitsLoss` which takes the raw values not sigmoid-transformed. It took some help from GPT to convert the tutorial regression model to a binary classification model. I hope this is correct.

I'm playing with 1-2 layers and different numbers of neurons, same as the tutorial. Dropout has been included, but not batching.


### Training and validation


```{python}
#| label: PlotRes
results_df = pd.read_csv("./model_out/gridsearch_results_cv.csv")

# Best config by mean CV validation AUC across all k folds
best_row = results_df.loc[results_df["mean_val_auc"].idxmax()]
hid_dim  = int(best_row["hid_dim"])
lr       = best_row["lr"]
dropout  = best_row["dropout"]

# Load per-fold histories for the best config
history_path = f"./model_out/history_cv_h{hid_dim}_lr{lr}_do{dropout}.pkl"
with open(history_path, "rb") as f:
    cv_hist = pickle.load(f)

# Load final model metrics evaluated on the held-out test set
with open("./model_out/final_test_results.pkl", "rb") as f:
    test_results = pickle.load(f)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 5))

# --- (1) Loss curves — one line per fold so fold-to-fold variance is visible ---
for fold in cv_hist["fold_histories"]:
    ax[0].plot(fold["loss_train"], color="steelblue",  alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.8)
    ax[0].plot(fold["loss_val"],   color="darkorange", alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.8)
ax[0].set_title(f"CV loss curves (k={len(cv_hist['fold_histories'])} folds)\n"
                f"hidden={hid_dim}, lr={lr}, dropout={dropout}")
ax[0].set_xlabel("Epoch")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Loss")
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax[0].legend([Line2D([0],[0],color="steelblue"), Line2D([0],[0],color="darkorange")],
             ["train", "val"])

# --- (2) Final test confusion matrix ---
cm = test_results["test_cm"]
ax[1].imshow(cm, cmap="Blues")
ax[1].set_title("Confusion matrix (held-out test set)")
ax[1].set_xticks([0, 1]); ax[1].set_yticks([0, 1])
ax[1].set_xticklabels(["Unburned", "Burned"])
ax[1].set_yticklabels(["Unburned", "Burned"])
ax[1].set_xlabel("Predicted"); ax[1].set_ylabel("True")
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(2):
        ax[1].text(j, i, cm[i, j], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12)

# --- (3) Final test ROC curve ---
ax[2].plot(test_results["test_fpr"], test_results["test_tpr"])
ax[2].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", color="grey")
ax[2].set_title(f"ROC curve — test set (AUC = {test_results['test_auc']:.3f})")
ax[2].set_xlabel("False Positive Rate")
ax[2].set_ylabel("True Positive Rate")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(f"\nCV best config: hidden={hid_dim}, lr={lr}, dropout={dropout}")
print(f"Mean CV AUC: {cv_hist['mean_val_auc']:.4f} ± {cv_hist['std_val_auc']:.4f}")
print(f"Test  AUC={test_results['test_auc']:.4f}  "
      f"Recall={test_results['test_recall']:.4f}  "
      f"Brier={test_results['test_brier']:.4f}")
```


### Prediction with two layer MLP


Load up the future climate data and subset the same predictor columns

```{python}
#| label: LoadFuture
#| eval: true
all_vars_future = pd.read_csv('../data/data_cmip6_fwivars_NorESM2-MMssp370.csv')
X_future = all_vars_future[["evergreen", "decid", "mixed", "forest", "wetland",
                   "unburnable", "tcc", "frac_Critical", "frac_Full",
                   "frac_Modified", "ysb_mean", "ysb_min", "ysb_max",
                   "elevation_1km", "slope_1km", "TPI_1km", "aspect_1km",
                   "flowacc_1km", "twi_1km", "fwi_summer_mean", "fwi_summer_max",
                   "fwi_summer_sum", "fwi_annual_mean", "fwi_annual_max", "fwi_annual_sum"]]
# load scaler
scaler = joblib.load("./model_out/scaler.pkl")

# Scale must use same trained scaler as in training
X_future_scaled = scaler.transform(X_future)
X_future_t = torch.FloatTensor(X_future_scaled).to(device)

```

#### Selecting a paramter set

Selecting the model with the highest validation AUC score:

```{python}
#| label: Pick
#| eval: true

# Load the saved final-model artefacts (best config + test metrics)
with open("./model_out/final_test_results.pkl", "rb") as f:
    final = pickle.load(f)

hid_dim_best  = int(final["hid_dim"])
lr_best       = float(final["lr"])
dropout_best  = float(final["dropout"])

checkpoint_path = os.path.join("./checkpoints", final["checkpoint"])
if not os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Checkpoint not found: {checkpoint_path}")

input_dimensions = X_future_scaled.shape[1]

print("\n" + "="*50)
print("Best Model (selected by mean CV AUC)")
print("="*50)
print(f"Hidden Dimension: {hid_dim_best}")
print(f"Learning Rate:    {lr_best}")
print(f"Dropout:          {dropout_best}")
print(f"Test AUC:         {final['test_auc']:.4f}")
print(f"Test Recall:      {final['test_recall']:.4f}")
print(f"Test Precision:   {final['test_precision']:.4f}")
print(f"Test Brier:       {final['test_brier']:.4f}")
print("="*50 + "\n")

# Rebuild model and load final trained weights
model_best = Feedforward(input_dimensions, hid_dim_best, dropout_best).to(device)
model_best.load_state_dict(torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location=device))
model_best.eval()

```

#### Run model with said parameter set to predict burns

```{python}
#| label: Predict
#| eval: true
# Make predictions on future climate data
with torch.no_grad():
    logits_future = model_best(X_future_t)
    probs_future = torch.sigmoid(logits_future)  # probability of burned
    preds_future = (probs_future > 0.5).float()  # binary predictions

preds_future_np = preds_future.cpu().numpy().squeeze()
probs_future_np = probs_future.cpu().numpy().squeeze()

# Compute prediction statistics
num_burned = int(preds_future_np.sum())
num_total = len(preds_future_np)
prop_burned = num_burned / num_total

# Print results
print("\n" + "="*50)
print("Future Climate Predictions")
print("="*50)
print(f"Total pixels: {num_total:,}")
print(f"Predicted burned: {num_burned:,}")
print(f"Predicted unburned: {num_total - num_burned:,}")
print(f"Burn probability: {prop_burned*100:.2f}%")
print(f"Mean predicted probability: {probs_future_np.mean():.4f}")
print(f"Std of predicted probability: {probs_future_np.std():.4f}")
print("="*50 + "\n")

# Save predictions to CSV for reproducibility
output_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'predicted_prob': probs_future_np,
    'predicted_binary': preds_future_np,
})
output_path = "./model_out/predictions_future.csv"
os.makedirs("./model_out", exist_ok=True)
output_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"✓ Predictions saved to {output_path}")

```
